About the Role

As a Corporate Development Analyst, you’ll be part of a highly analytical team working on strategic initiatives that shape GoTo’s growth and direction. You’ll gain hands-on exposure to capital market strategy, valuation, M&A, deal structuring, strategic partnerships, and portfolio management.

Beyond financial analysis, you’ll work closely with different teams and stakeholders to evaluate opportunities, develop strategic recommendations, and support some of GoTo’s most important corporate development decisions.

What Will You Do

• Provide financial and strategic analysis related to the company’s funding and capital markets strategy, M&A, portfolio management and strategic partnerships
• Develop financial models and valuation analyses that help guide the decision making process
• Conduct industry and market research related to trends, risks, opportunities and competitive landscape
• Participate in deals end-to-end, including strategy development, deal negotiation & structuring, due diligence and coordinating with finance, legal, tax and other departments to ensure seamless deal execution
• Create investment memorandums and related presentations for senior management, board and shareholders
• Prepare regular and ad-hoc investor and management reporting

What Will You Need

• At least 2 years of work experience in private equity, corporate development, Big 4 advisory, investment banking, management consulting and/or related experience
• Good grasp of accounting, finance, and legal/tax considerations in M&A and corporate finance
• Solid analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving skills with high level of attention to details
• Works well under pressure to achieve tight timelines while producing high quality outputs
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask
• Ability to manage confidential and highly sensitive information with the highest levels of discretion and professionalism
• Strong communications and collaboration skills. Excellent verbal and written fluency in English and Bahasa Indonesia

About the Team

Our team focuses on financial and strategic analysis to support the company’s funding, M&A, portfolio management, and partnerships. We build financial models, conduct industry research, and help drive key decisions through detailed valuation work.

We are involved end-to-end in deal execution—from strategy and negotiation to due diligence and coordination with internal teams. We also prepare investment memos and investor reports to support senior management and stakeholders.

With a strong foundation in finance, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration, we operate with a high level of professionalism, attention to detail, and strategic focus.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.
